ratings.reviewer_notes: Identifies IL-17/IFN-gamma-producing Th1-like Th17 CD4+ T cells and links them to multiple autoimmune diseases.
Directly identifies Th17 CD4+ T cells, gamma-delta T cells, NKT cells, and innate lymphoid cells as type 17 cytokine producers contributing to autoimmune inflammation.
Direct review of IL-17-producing Th17 cells and their pathogenic functions in human and mouse autoimmune disease.
Identifies gamma-delta 17 T cells and CD4+ Th17 cells as major IL-17 producers in inflammatory disease models and relevant human disorders.
In SLE, associates excessive IL-17 with CD4+ T cells/Th17 cells and describes IL-17+ CD4-CD8- double-negative T cells derived from CD8+ T cells.
Provides adjacent IL-23/IL-12 pathway context and discusses pathogenic helper T cells in autoimmune disorders, but the abstract does not directly identify IL-17-associated cell types.
Directly compares IL-17-producing gamma-delta T cells, alpha-beta T cells, and innate lymphoid cells in human and experimental spondyloarthritis.
Directly associates IL-17-producing Th17 helper T cells with rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, multiple sclerosis, and inflammatory bowel disease.
Reviews innate lymphoid cells as cytokine producers in autoimmune and rheumatic diseases, but the abstract does not explicitly identify IL-17 production.
Directly reviews Th17 cells, their key cytokine IL-17, and the IL-23/IL-17 axis in immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.
Mechanistically studies IL-17A/IL-17F-producing Th17 cells and their differentiation into pathogenic effectors in inflammatory disease models.
Directly addresses Th17-cell lineage, effector functions, and the IL-23/IL-17 axis in immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.
Focuses on IL-22 production by Th17 cells and ILC3s rather than identifying immune-cell associations with IL-17.
Direct review of pathogenic and non-pathogenic IL-17A-producing CD4+ Th17 cells in autoimmune disease.
Associates IL-17A production with innate-like lymphocytes and innate lymphoid cells in autoimmune-mediated inflammatory arthritis.
Explicitly identifies Th17 cells, gamma-delta T cells, and type 3 innate lymphoid cells as ROR-gamma-t-expressing cell types in IL-17-driven autoimmune inflammation.
Provides adjacent evidence on Th17 cells in autoimmune disorders, with emphasis on obesity-related metabolism rather than mapping multiple IL-17-associated immune cell types.
Directly discusses Th17 cells and other, especially innate, immune-cell sources of IL-17 in autoimmune disease.
Direct review of Th17/T-cell production of IL-17 family cytokines and their involvement in numerous autoimmune diseases.
Mechanistically characterizes IL-17+ intestinal Th17 populations and their conversion into pathogenic effector T cells during CNS autoimmunity.
Broad IL-17 review that mentions IL-23 activation of Th17 cells and autoimmunity, but gives limited immune-cell mapping.
Identifies Th17, CD8+ T, gamma-delta T, NKT, and innate lymphoid-like cells as IL-17A producers, but the review primarily concerns cancer rather than autoimmune disease networks.
